mapper.insert: INSERT INTO openbiz_shop_inventory (tenant_id, product_id, quantity, version, update_time) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{version}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, product_id, quantity, version, update_time FROM openbiz_shop_inventory WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} LIMIT 1
